verdict.rationale: Algolia documents its own custom ranking feature and rules that override relevance. It states that ranking uses non-textual factors beyond text matching, and it adds merchandising boosting and personalized ranking. A community user confirms ordering stories by popularity or date. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs showing custom ranking on specific business attributes such as popularity, recency and margin, detail on how ranking criteria are configured and combined, and independent hands-on corroboration of tuning with business signals.

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching

citations.quote: Apply custom ranking to adapt Algolia to your needs.
non-textual factors such as criteria and geolocation
Use rules to override relevance in some situations. For example, for seasonal product promotions.
